description_sq: Apartamenti ndodhet ne zonen midis 21 Dhjetorit dhe Parkut.Pozicionohet ne katin e katert te nje ndertimi egzistues pa ashensor.Organizohet nga nje ambient ndenje sebashku me kendin gatimit,nje dhome gjumi,nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.Orientimi lindje-perendim i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate dites.Prona disponon dekumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni.
description_en: The apartment is located in the area between 21 Djetori and the Park. It is located on the fourth floor of an existing building without an elevator. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. The east-west orientation allows natural light during the day. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, contact us.
